note: The other leaf of the same round. `ArtWash` covers every band; these three surfaces draw a commander at thumb size instead, and five renders converged on the two boxes `CommanderThumb` owns. Separate inventory because `check:shared` takes one binding, and a row whose view renders a different leaf would have to be dropped rather than checked.
